notes.title: March 30 Patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The game has been patched with these updates:
1. AI improved for ranged units. Mainly, they are less likely to move to the front lines.
2. Updated some sound effects.
3. Tweaked some interfaces’ positionings on lower resolution screens.
4. Smoother map dragging/panning.

Do let us know if the updates have improved your gameplay experience, or if you have more suggestions!

notes.title: Tiny Guardians Patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We updated the game with some changes:
1. The start button no longer disappears in smaller resolutions.
2. Credits interface glitch fixed.
3. Map panning is now smoother.

If you have any suggestions regarding the controls, please let us know. We will try to update them for a better gaming experience in Tiny Guardians!
